info.name: Tradeshift External Dx Category Documents Document Files API

params.name: since
params.description: Limits documents to those which have changed since the given timestamp, formatted as a ISO 8601 XSD-timestamp.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: List only those files that were created after this date.

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: List only those files that were created before this date.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of files to be shown at once as part of the first page or for every page.

params.name: noPaging
params.description:
To disable any paging and either return all files or just the first few files as
specified by the limit parameter. This parameter supersedes the page parameter.

params.name: recursive
params.description: Recursively include subdirectories, accepted as values 'true' or 'false'.

params.name: directory
params.description: The absolute path of the directory to list files from.

params.name: listDirectories
params.description: List directory definitions including '.' and subdirectories.

params.name: fileNames
params.description: List of file names to look for.

params.name: acceptAs
params.description: Regex file name patterns to use to search for files.

params.name: state
params.description:
The state of the document files to show; 'new' for non dispatched, 'failed', for ones
with validation errors, 'dispatched' for dispatched documents, 'dispatch_failed' for
ones where dispatch has failed.

params.name: requireDocumentId
params.description: List only those files that have an associated document id.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of the query
